application: manual-only; never merge this file as a FusionFix configuration

evidence.scope: source-reviewed; installed FusionFix build and Steam 1.0.0.1 runtime unverified

preserve: all existing settings unless a single study below is explicitly selected
gameplay, simulation, AI, progression and vehicle performance

requirements: the installed build exposes this exact setting
do not lower an already higher user setting automatically
restart game; compare identical shadow scene and frame times
shadow-detail.limits: Device caps and atlas cascade count can clamp the effective resolution; 4096 is a request, not a verified allocation.

requirements: test separately from shadow-detail and scenery studies
start only from CSMScale=1, CSMScaleNear=15, CSMScaleMid=90, CSMScaleFar=510
restart game and inspect cascade transition flicker and distant aliasing
shadow-far-range.limits: A larger cascade extent may spread existing texels more thinly; no verified draw distance in metres and no guaranteed quality improvement.

requirements: test on the same high-speed route separately from shadow changes
restore the captured original value if pop-in, excess draw calls or instability appears
scenery-last-lod.limits: Source changes the scenery mask from 0x0E to 0x0F; this exposes the last scenery LOD step, not arbitrary geometry or vehicle LOD distances.
